notes.title: One Year in Early Access
notes.content:
After more than one hundred patches, several thousands of bug fixes, tweaks and adjustments it is time to conclude [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807360/Dreadful_River/]Dreadful Rivers[/url][/b] first year of being in Early Access.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBHbkOh01zM
 
Since the first release in February 28, 2023 a bunch of new content has found its way into the game:

[list]
[*]way, WAY better performance
[*]and still better graphics
[*]the SEARCH FOR THE CROWNSTONES mainquest branch is fully implemented
[*]a gateway town  where the river branches into the three biomes was introduced
[*]there are now forts to conquer
[*]and more factions
[*]there’s wildlife, hunting and fishing
[*]on land ruins, mines, caves, and ancient starling halls are waiting to be explored
[*]skill trees, including special crown skills
[*]more character classes for hire
[*]siege engines
[*]crew members can be positioned on the raft
[*]nicer to use inventory system
[*]more stuff to collect, use, craft and cook
[*]loads of general QoL and bugfixes
[*]Achievements
[/list]

[b]Now what’s next?[/b]

[list]
[*]the underworld biome
[*]more gear, spells, weapons
[*]additional crafting plans and cooking recipes
[*]new skilltrees
[*]various new enemy types
[*]new siege engine types
[*]new factions
[*]more dungeons
[*]overall more river[/list]

For the future we are also experimenting with different game ideas in the background to follow up the development of Dreadful River. One of them is [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2718570/They_Came_From_Venus/]THEY CAME FROM VENUS[/url][/b], another one was in cryostasis for some years now and will be revealed in some weeks time.

Ending our update post with an obligatory [i]busy-working-on-stuff picture.[/i]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/3357962/302faa2a0e5a2f16e281252215556596f560fed2.jpg[/img]

See you next time  :)

notes.title: Two Months
notes.content:
Two months have passed since the Early Access release. We are happy that you continue to explore the river and its surroundings and give us your feedback! Many new features have been added recently:

[list]
[*] You can now ride elevators to explore the dungeons in the Starling Ruins.

[*] The inventory now has tabs.
[*] Healing potions can be activated directly from the inventory.
[*] Stamina and mana are displayed.
[*] You can hire priests to heal your crew.
[*] Another new class is the Berserker, which can fight with two weapons.
[*] On land you can now sprint.
[/list]


Here you can see the latest updates:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1807360?updates=true]Latest changes[/url]

Feedback and bug reports will be answered and processed as soon as possible. Keep it up!

[list]
[*] New enemy types
[*] Custom siege weapons
[*] More dungeons, cities and environments
[/list]
... and soon even more. Keep letting us know your ideas and suggestions!

notes.content:
Ten days since the Early Access release. A big thank you to everyone who is accompanying us on the journey on the river!

During this time we've been busy and released some updates: 
[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1807360?updates=true]latest changes[/url][/b]

We continue to try to process feedback and bug reports as quickly as possible. Please keep it up, we appreciate your messages! We need your input because we want to constantly improve your gaming experience.

[h3]Bigger updates coming soon[/h3]

[b][list]
[*] Fishing from the raft
[*] Hunting wild animals on land
[*] The first Crown Stone for the main mission
[/list][/b]

More features are in the works. What other ideas and suggestions do you have? Let us know!
